Course sans fin sur trois voies dans une: An endless three-lane run through a neon city at night: jump barriers, slide under signs, switch lanes before the subway train (some rush towards you). Coloured signs announce each obstacle and the speed gradually doubles. Score: distance plus 5 points per coin; keyboard, mouse or swipe; record and statistics kept. A street lined with buildings and four districts that follow each other every 400 m (neon centre, harbour, rooftops, subway); magnet, shield and skateboard bonuses; five characters to buy with your coins; full screen and a game that fits the screen.
